outcome: Incidence of moderate-to-severe pain after cesarean delivery
cohort: 644 patients aged 18 years or older undergoing elective cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia with intrathecal morphine
finding: The study found a high incidence (70.03%) of moderate-to-severe postoperative pain after a single dose of spinal morphine for cesarean delivery, with gestational diabetes and intraoperative tubal sterilization being significantly associated with increased pain.
